text: Owner said 'keep working and pushing forward' (2026-10-01): proceed with the pilot build. Custody-separation default, since agents share one OS user so file modes cannot separate authors from the custodian: sealed raw outputs are encrypted (age or openssl hybrid) to an OWNER-held public key whose private key never resides on this machine. The custodian computes the whitelist in-run and publishes only the whitelist plus digests. S9 implements and tests this. The owner can override.
